description: Prisma CLI: database resets, migrations and database writes, and schema commands.

rules.note: `migrate reset` drops the database. The two options accept data loss. `-n` is `--name`, not a dry run.

safe.note: Client generation, schema checks, and the local data browser.
`migrate status` and `migrate diff` only read and print.

writes.note: `migrate dev`, `migrate deploy`, and `migrate resolve` change the database or its migration history. `db push`, `db execute`, and `db seed` change the database. They are remote writes, also on a development database, so they are not known safe (dev round 3).
